page_title: Journey Through the Nine Functions | CORE9 RESOLVE™
heading: Journey Through the Nine Functions
intro: Explore how the nine core functions flow as one living system—from envisioning a future and building trust to expanding your impact, restoring vitality, and renewing the cycle.
notice_body: Drag to orbit in 3D, scroll to zoom, or click any glowing node (01–09) to focus on that function and step through its story.
closing: Want to see where these functions show up in your life or business today? Start with one of the three Reflections or explore any interactive function story above.

tiles.name: Strategy
tiles.question: What Future Is Waiting for You to Create?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to imagine a future that doesn't exist yet—and begin creating it.

tiles.name: Relationships
tiles.question: What Makes You Feel Truly Connected?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to understand others, build trust, and create relationships where people feel heard, valued, and willing to work together.

tiles.name: Analysis & Systems
tiles.question: What Happens When You See Only Part of the Picture?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to understand how different elements connect, recognize patterns and consequences, and build a coherent framework for decisions and action.

tiles.name: Knowledge & Priorities
tiles.question: When Everything Seems Important, What Do You Choose?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to recognize what matters, discover new possibilities, and choose where to direct your attention and energy.

tiles.name: Contribution & Expansion
tiles.question: What If Your Contribution Could Reach Further Than You Imagine?
tiles.summary: Function 5 is the center of the nine-function system—turning the foundation of Functions 1–4 into outward contribution without burnout.

tiles.name: Psychology, Beauty & Fulfillment
tiles.question: What If Feeling Wonderful Wasn't a Reward, but a Way of Living?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to create a life in which beauty, comfort, nourishment, pleasure, love, and emotional satisfaction are natural parts of your everyday experience.

tiles.name: Mission & Action
tiles.question: What If the Work Could Give You Energy Instead of Taking It Away?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to discover what brings your abilities alive, see hidden connections, restore movement in difficult situations, and turn possibilities into reality.

tiles.name: Material Results
tiles.question: What If You Could Build More Wealth Without Working Harder?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to create, organize, and sustain material prosperity without continually increasing the demands on your time, energy, money, and personal resources.

tiles.name: Completion & Renewal
tiles.question: What If Every Completion Brought You Closer to an Extraordinary Achievement?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to recognize when something has fulfilled its purpose, discover what remains valuable, and open a new chapter.
